page: Microsoft Azure FX64-16mds_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmdsv2 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 260 MB L3 cache. This server is equipped with 1344.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 84.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, providing 3780 GB of capacity, and the instance is premium storage capable. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data shows average performance across several core compute and memory metrics, with specific areas of strength. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 2168.28, and the multi-core score is 17738.0, both falling within the average range. Memory bandwidth for read-only small blocks is 1378.77 GB/sec, while large-block write bandwidth is strong at 91.75 GB/sec. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression show strong performance at 34.06 GB/sec and 14.78 GB/sec respectively. For database operations, the PassMark database score is 11083.73, and Redis SET operations reach 24.29 million operations per second, both representing average tier performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the FX64-16mds_v2 offers a highly specialized hardware profile characterized by an exceptionally high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local storage. This resource density makes it a qualitative match for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel CPU scaling but demand large in-memory footprints. The server is suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
